baseline.worktree: Existing functional-network documents and uncommitted first-pass fixes preserved.

scope.meaning: Agent capacity, lease sync/execution admission, queued user-check lifetime and bounded response decoding. Browser behavior was source-inspected but not changed or dynamically accepted.

findings.summary: Claim route passed free slots as total active capacity, double-counting already reported jobs.
findings.fix: Use reported active_jobs + available_slots; queue counts outstanding/cancel-pending leases once. Do not replace this with registered maximum, which could consume reserved capacity.

findings.summary: Bundled client ignored lost_job_ids before execution, then reported a completed probe or cancellation acknowledgement for that lost lease.
findings.fix: Return a retryable conflict before execution or result submission. Lost status takes precedence over a cancellation instruction for the same job.

findings.summary: Unclaimed user checks had no expiry, so lost submit/cancel responses could permanently consume both per-user slots.
findings.fix: 35-second user-owned queue wait limit, reaped on next access. Source and user active quota are released; claimed deadlines and staff-managed unowned job behavior remain unchanged.

findings.summary: Unknown-length HTTP responses were fully buffered before the 640 KiB check; an oversized unfinished response waited for EOF/request timeout.
findings.fix: Incremental chunk checks reject before retaining bytes above the cap, including error responses. Exact-limit JSON and ordinary error classification remain supported.

before_fix.note: Initial Rust failures: capacity (1), lost lease (2), abandoned queue (1), unfinished oversized response (1). Additional preservation/boundary tests were added after those reproductions.

new_tests.note: Included in full-suite totals, not additive to the focused subsets.

checks.scope: File lengths, version/course/OpenAPI/SDK drift/compatibility, common Node tests, fixture-based Agent/distribution/kernel-smoke/candidate checks, Rust formatting; not full frontend/SDK runtime or real kernel acceptance.

checks.note: Seven cumulative referenced-source changes; API/access/page/catalog inventories are unchanged. The original source manifest and earlier reports were not rehashed.

environment.database: DATABASE_URL and CYANREX_TEST_DATABASE_URL unset for tests.
environment.protocol: Synthetic ephemeral 127.0.0.1 listeners, scope-aborted after each test; no connection to deployed Engine or external Agent.
environment.compiler_scope: The pre-existing executor test invokes installed Clang on synthetic source and cleans its workspace. It allows a non-timeout compile failure, so this is not proof of successful BPF compilation. No kernel load/attach is performed.
environment.data: Synthetic fixtures only; no deployed classroom data or service configuration modified.

not_run: New benchmarks or dependency security audits
Frontend build and SDK runtime tests
remaining_limits: Queue reaping is access-triggered, not a background timer; idle queues can retain expired source until accessed.
Terminal metadata retains the global 512-record and 15-minute retention limits.
Staff-managed unowned jobs still require claim or explicit cancellation.
Lost-lease checks are pre-execution; compilation already in progress is not continuously monitored or immediately interrupted.
No automatic resubmission, new idempotency key, remote loading or client-side execution parallelism.
Response cap bounds retained body length, not all transport allocations or process memory.

next_candidates.note: Diagnostic cache keys omit Engine/session scope; late-response and shared cancellation behavior need focused browser reproduction before implementation.
